turns.text: What is HIMS in the ABDM context?

must_contain: the catalogue's term is HMIS, not HIMS
HMIS is NHA's term for the software a hospital runs day to day
a facility uses its HMIS to publish records as the HIP and to fetch them as the HIU, so the ABDM work is M2 and M3 either way
an HMIS must implement every HI type, not only the ones it already produces
notes: reader spelled it HIMS; catalogue atom shared.glossary.hmis spells it HMIS (hospital management information system).
